```{=html}
<!DOCTYPE html>
<html>
<head>
  <meta charset="UTF-8">
  <meta http-equiv="refresh" content="0; URL=roadmap.html">
  <title>30-Day CDISC Clinical Programming Mastery</title>
  <style>
    @import url('https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=IBM+Plex+Mono:wght@400;500;600&family=Playfair+Display:ital,wght@0,400;0,600;1,400&display=swap');
    
    * { margin: 0; padding: 0; box-sizing: border-box; }
    
    body {
      font-family: 'Playfair Display', Georgia, serif;
      background: linear-gradient(135deg, #0f172a 0%, #1e293b 100%);
      color: #f1f5f9;
      min-height: 100vh;
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
    }
    
    .redirect-container {
      text-align: center;
      padding: 60px 40px;
      max-width: 600px;
    }
    
    .label {
      font-family: 'IBM Plex Mono', monospace;
      font-size: 11px;
      letter-spacing: 3px;
      text-transform: uppercase;
      color: #64748b;
      margin-bottom: 16px;
    }
    
    h1 {
      font-size: 28px;
      font-weight: 600;
      margin-bottom: 12px;
      letter-spacing: -0.5px;
    }
    
    .subtitle {
      font-size: 14px;
      color: #94a3b8;
      font-style: italic;
      margin-bottom: 40px;
    }
    
    .redirect-msg {
      font-family: 'IBM Plex Mono', monospace;
      font-size: 12px;
      color: #64748b;
      margin-bottom: 20px;
    }
    
    .spinner {
      width: 40px;
      height: 40px;
      border: 3px solid #334155;
      border-top-color: #38bdf8;
      border-radius: 50%;
      animation: spin 1s linear infinite;
      margin: 0 auto 24px;
    }
    
    @keyframes spin {
      to { transform: rotate(360deg); }
    }
    
    .link {
      display: inline-block;
      font-family: 'IBM Plex Mono', monospace;
      font-size: 12px;
      padding: 10px 24px;
      background: rgba(56,189,248,0.1);
      border: 1px solid #38bdf8;
      border-radius: 6px;
      color: #38bdf8;
      text-decoration: none;
      transition: all 0.2s;
    }
    
    .link:hover {
      background: rgba(56,189,248,0.2);
      transform: translateY(-2px);
    }
  </style>
</head>
<body>
  <div class="redirect-container">
    <div class="label">Pharmaverse R Onboarding</div>
    <h1>30-Day CDISC Clinical Programming Mastery</h1>
    <p class="subtitle">CDISC · SDTM · ADaM · Admiral · FDA-Ready</p>
    <div class="spinner"></div>
    <p class="redirect-msg">Redirecting to the roadmap...</p>
    <a href="roadmap.html" class="link">Click here if not redirected</a>
  </div>
</body>
</html>
```
